digest.component_or_area: reclaim window helper and backup infrastructure
propositions: Prepare an off-repository Git bundle and JSON manifest of live origin refs without performing any remote ref deletion or push operations
Enumerate every live origin head and tag at runtime with exact direct and peeled OIDs, collapsing annotated-tag ^{} lines and recording each ref's ancestry relationship to the old tip
Create and verify the bundle from temporary refs in a fresh unfiltered clone, then restore and validate the bundle reproduces exact old-tip and pin-tip OIDs without modifying remote state

Refuse partial/promisor clones, pre-existing reclaim-backup refs, and output artifacts inside the repository Git directory or registered worktrees; clean up only the invocation-specific namespace on success or caught failure
Record manifest and bundle SHA-256 checksums, byte sizes, old tip OID, included pin-tip OIDs, and successful bundle verification output in a ticket comment for A6-1 consumption
